title: KV/Context Memory Baseline
safe_context_length: c=8192 or below — RAM-resident, no meaningful swap
danger_context_length: c=16384 — swap activated (+394 MB), process survived but OS is paging

kv_reduction_targets.75pct_reduction: makes c=16384 comfortable, c=32768 potentially survivable

policy_1_sliding_window.description: Keep most recent N tokens, evict old KV entries
policy_1_sliding_window.effectiveness: high for single-turn, medium for multi-turn

policy_2_summary_replacement.description: Summarize old context into compact text, drop old KV

policy_3_importance_based.description: Pin system prompt, user constraints, tool results, facts; evict filler
policy_3_importance_based.effectiveness: potentially high if salience detection works

policy_4_contextos_packetization.description: Convert old context to structured memory packet, keep compact active prompt
cons: Requires integration layer between inference and memory

policy_5_hybrid.description: Recent window + structured summary + pinned facts

rationale: Clear success criterion: reduces swap at c=16384
Baseline for measuring whether more complex policies are needed
Well-known pattern in production LLM systems
recommended_first_policy.if_insufficient: Evaluate Policy 4 (ContextOS packetization) as next step

success_criteria.quality: <10% degradation on eval prompts vs no-eviction baseline
success_criteria.memory_monitoring: Memory pressure monitor can detect swap risk and trigger eviction
success_criteria.integration: Can be called from Smart Agent Router policy layer

kill_criteria.quality: Any automated semantic canary fails on common prompts
kill_criteria.memory_savings: KV eviction provides <20% memory reduction at c=16384
kill_criteria.latency: Per-token decode time increases >50% vs no-eviction
kill_criteria.complexity: Requires more than 3 new config knobs to tune
kill_criteria.real_prompts: Fails on real long-context prompts Matt actually uses
